intent.description: Deploy a local Git repository end to end to a self-hosted VPS managed by Coolify. Use when the user asks to deploy or publish the current or named local project, connect GitHub push auto-deploy, or verify that a new commit was automatically redeployed. Own local repo -> private GitHub -> Coolify VPS delivery, Application versus Service choice, editable environment variables, domains and Traefik reachability, persistence, health checks, webhook deployment evidence, HTTPS, logs, and runtime status. Also trigger for Chinese requests such as “把当前项目部署到 Coolify”, “提交 GitHub 后自动重新部署”, “配置 Coolify 自动部署”, “用这个域名一键部署”, or “改造后部署到我的服务器”. Do not use for Vercel or Cloudflare Pages delivery, generic SSH-only VPS provisioning without Coolify, pure DNS explanations, local-only Docker runs, or routine restart/log inspection without a deployment or auto-deploy outcome.

output_contract: public URL and final runtime status
GitHub repository, branch, and deployed commit
auto-deploy mode, configuration state, baseline ID, webhook deployment UUID/source, and commit match
Coolify project/environment/resource name and short UUID
environment-variable keys changed, with values masked
DNS/TLS, health, logs, and route verification results

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only GitHub and Coolify inspection before scoped writes

permissions.network: GitHub, configured Coolify instance, target application domains, and optional DNS provider
permissions.file_write: deployment-related files in the target repository and this skill package only
permissions.subprocess: git, gh, repository-defined quality commands, bundled API, inspection, smoke, and verification scripts
permissions.remote_write: project-scoped GitHub/Coolify/DNS writes and native auto-deploy settings required by an explicit deployment request
permissions.interactive: only when authentication or a destructive-conflict decision requires the user

degradation.api_unavailable: stop remote writes, report the Coolify API health or authentication blocker, and keep local inspection results
degradation.mcp_unavailable: continue through the Coolify REST API when it is healthy; MCP is optional
degradation.dns_write_unavailable: deploy the resource and report the exact DNS record required
degradation.github_write_unavailable: stop before source publication and report the authentication blocker
degradation.provider_evidence_unavailable: label runtime claims as missing evidence

local: scan tracked filenames for likely secrets
remote: GitHub App repository access and exact auto-deploy branch
completion: when auto-deploy is requested: post-baseline webhook deployment matches the pushed full commit SHA

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
